about: Freeman-era Notre Dame starting quarterbacks, one entry per SEASON (the same person can start more than one season: CJ Carr is carr25 and carr26, with shorts that carry the season so legends, pills, tables and game logs stay unambiguous). The newest season is the current QB; every earlier season is a comparison QB. To start a new season, add one entry (key, name, short, season, espn_id) and the pipeline backfills or tracks everything else. final_totals are the published season totals the stored game log must reconcile to; add them when a season ends.

qbs.name: Riley Leonard
qbs.note: led Notre Dame to the College Football Playoff national championship game (14–2)

qbs.name: CJ Carr
qbs.note: went 10–2 in his first season as the starter

tabs.about: RB and WR tabs: 'current' names the current season's players per season (in display order: the first is drawn solid, the second dashed). A season without an entry uses Notre Dame's top 'count' players at 'positions' by yards. Earlier seasons always use that top-by-yards rule. Team tab: Notre Dame's seasons from the QB list above, plus the current AP Top 5.
